generation.method: Recorded from complete live Git process captures and the installed npm shim source, with values replaced by typed placeholders after inspection.
generation.generator: manual redaction from credential-free commands and installed-source reads

schemaSemantics.textOutputs: The recorded stdout and stderr values retain the complete observed line grammar. Parser-specific accepted grammars retain every character class the implementation reads.
schemaSemantics.source: The npm shim lines are the complete installed codex.cmd source after local installation paths were removed. The referenced JavaScript path and existence result remain recorded.
schemaSemantics.credentials: No token, cookie, credential, private key, personal content, repository URL, or unredacted local path is retained.

gitLsRemote.commandCompleteness: Complete argv with the repository path supplied as cwd and the ref replaced by a named placeholder.

provenance.captureKind: complete stdout, stderr, and exit-code capture with the SHA and repository path redacted

comparedFields.sha: must be exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters
comparedFields.ref: must equal the requested ref after the tab or other Git whitespace separator

gitRemoteOrigin.commandCompleteness: Complete argv with the repository path supplied as cwd.

provenance.captureKind: complete stdout, stderr, and exit-code capture with the remote URL redacted after grammar inspection

comparedFields.repository: the captured owner/repository must equal the requested --repo value, case-insensitively

gitDiffPatch.commandCompleteness: Complete argv with the repository path supplied as cwd and both authenticated commit SHAs supplied as named placeholders.

provenance.captureKind: complete stdout, stderr, and exit-code capture with the repository path and commit SHAs replaced by named placeholders

gitDiffPatch.observedStdout:
diff --git a/<path> b/<path>
deleted file mode 100644
index <sha>..<sha>
--- a/<path>
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1 +0,0 @@
-<removed line>
diff --git a/<path> b/<path>
index <sha>..<sha> 100644
--- a/<path>
+++ b/<path>
@@ -1 +1 @@
-<old line>
+<changed line>

comparedFields.patch: stdout is copied as the complete authenticated base-to-head patch and is not parsed by the launcher

gitRevParseHead.commandCompleteness: Complete argv with the detached review worktree supplied as cwd.

provenance.captureKind: complete stdout, stderr, and exit-code capture with the commit SHA and worktree path redacted

comparedFields.head: the trimmed output must equal the exact SHA used to create the detached review worktree

gitStatusPorcelain.commandCompleteness: Complete argv with the detached review worktree supplied as cwd.

provenance.captureKind: complete stdout, stderr, and exit-code capture from a clean detached review worktree

comparedFields.status: the trimmed stdout is empty for removal; any non-empty trimmed stdout preserves the worktree for inspection

comparedFields.script: the captured relative JavaScript path is resolved beside the shim and must name an existing file

root.cleanup: git worktree remove checkout, then rmSync(review-root, { recursive: true })
root.dirtyBehavior: preserve the review root and artifact
